decision.observation: 6:00 pm, Sat. 6; the C press reeled the line up (bobber airborne at ~(0.63,0.10) above the farmer's head). The pond is just below with rings left in the water.
decision.hypothesis: Recasting (hold C) will land the bobber in the pond; a subsequent dip/'HIT!' press of C has produced catches today, so fishing remains viable for evening income.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip/'HIT!' cue, then hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish if the minigame opens. Catches so far: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola ×2 (day 6).
